tasks.title: Quick Actions — Card templates moves to the individual card

fields.You asked: remove Card templates from the Quick Action parent section; keep it on each action card.
fields.How I check it: select the Quick Actions section — no Card templates. Select one card — it has its own. ⚠️ Worth knowing: it lives on the parent today precisely so every card in a row shares a shape. Per-card means a row can hold four different shapes — the point of the change, and its cost.
fields.Verified: Quick Actions section panel has no Card templates (its Content section drops entirely). Each action card has all four tiles and they WORK per card — setting New Incident to Icon top left its three siblings icon-left.

fields.How I check it: Widgets → Custom has no "Action Card" row, and typing "action" into the search does not surface it either.

tasks.title: Add an External link button from the Quick Action section's sidebar

fields.How I check it: select Quick Actions — there is a way to add an external-link button, what it adds lands in that row, and it opens the URL you set.

tasks.title: Action cards cannot be placed on their own

fields.You asked: an action card belongs only inside the Quick Actions parent section, never as a standalone block. So no duplicate on its floating toolbar, and no way to add one from the widget sidebar.
fields.How I check it: the Actions rows are gone from the library, and an action card's toolbar has no duplicate. ⚠️ The toolbar is shared, so duplicate has to be disabled for this kind rather than removed from the bar — I check it still works everywhere else.

tasks.title: Action cards — remove the ACTION section from the panel

fields.You asked: remove the Action section from all four cards' sidebars — New Incident, Request Service, AD Self Service, Knowledge.
fields.How I check it: select each of the four — the panel goes Content → Design with no Action section, so On-click-go-to and Most used services are both gone. Their destinations come from the card's own identity.
